name: igi-vita
description: Project I.G.I. native PS Vita port - releases (no game files)
long_description: Project I.G.I. (Innerloop, 2000) running natively on the PS Vita / PS TV. This is not an emulator: the original Windows executable was statically recompiled to C and built for the Vita, with Direct3D 7 / DirectSound / DirectInput reimplemented on top of vitaGL and the Vita's own APIs. Hot parts of the game (terrain, meshes, skinning, culling...) have been rewritten by hand for the Vita's CPU.
